target_audience: Rural Healthcare Workers, Doctors, District Health Admins, and Elderly Patients in North East India

theme.background_feeling: Warm Bone Sand & Clinical Mint Surface

rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800
rules.elderly_mode: Increases base text sizes by 1.2x (text-lg body, text-3xl headings) with elevated contrast (APCA compliant AAA)

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-emerald-900/10 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
visual_enhancers.glass_nav: bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-emerald-900/10 sticky top-0 z-50
visual_enhancers.disclaimer_banner: bg-amber-50 border-l-4 border-amber-500 p-4 text-amber-900 font-medium text-sm rounded-r-xl

key_components_to_build.name: NavigationHeader
key_components_to_build.description: Sticky navigation with role indicator (Healthcare Worker / Doctor / Admin), Language toggle (English / Assamese / Bengali), Sync Status Badge, and Navigation links.

key_components_to_build.name: LandingPage
key_components_to_build.description: Hero section featuring North East India health outreach story, MPU6050 IoT sensor explainer, interactive trial demo link, and key impact statistics.

key_components_to_build.name: SensorDashboard
key_components_to_build.description: Real-time MPU6050 sensor stream (Accelerometer AccX, AccY, AccZ and Gyroscope GyroX, GyroY, GyroZ), live chart telemetry, signal quality indicator, WebSocket connection toggle, and zero-calibration trigger.

key_components_to_build.name: AIPredictionScreen
key_components_to_build.description: Interactive AI analysis with animated circular probability progress gauge, Knee Stability Score, Movement Symmetry %, Balance Index, contributing sensor factor breakdown, and mandatory disclaimer 'AI-assisted screening, not a medical diagnosis'.

key_components_to_build.name: PatientRegistration
key_components_to_build.description: Accessible patient registration form with regional village selector (Guwahati, Dibrugarh, Silchar, Tezpur, Jorhat, etc.), mobility assessment checklist, and medical history.

key_components_to_build.name: PatientRecords
key_components_to_build.description: Patient directory with search, risk filter tabs, screening history cards, doctor review status, and PDF report generator with embedded verification QR code.

key_components_to_build.name: DoctorReview
key_components_to_build.description: Doctor portal for reviewing flagged high-risk OA cases, appending digital clinical notes, confirming or overriding risk tier, and prescribing physiotherapy protocols.

key_components_to_build.name: AnalyticsDashboard
key_components_to_build.description: Recharts data visualizations for Total Patients, High-Risk Cohorts, Monthly Screening Trends, Age Distribution, Village-wise Case Density, and Knee Stability averages.

key_components_to_build.name: AwarenessHub
key_components_to_build.description: Multilingual educational resource center with knee exercise animations, early OA sign guide, diet recommendations, and downloadable PDF pamphlets.

key_components_to_build.name: OfflineSyncManager
key_components_to_build.description: IndexedDB offline queue manager showing pending local records, network connectivity monitor, auto-sync toggle, and elderly accessibility contrast/font size controls.

image_urls.description: Rural doctor examining elderly patient in health clinic
Healthcare worker conducting physical joint evaluation
Knee joint sensor therapy pads during mobility assessment
Physiotherapy joint examination and leg stability test

accessibility_and_elderly_rules.font_size_multiplier: Support global toggle for normal (100%) and large (125%) text sizing
accessibility_and_elderly_rules.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height on all buttons and interactive controls for healthcare workers in remote conditions
accessibility_and_elderly_rules.color_contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for standard text, 3:1 for large headers
accessibility_and_elderly_rules.disclaimer: Every AI prediction screen MUST include prominent disclaimer: 'AI-assisted screening, not a medical diagnosis'

testing_requirements.data_testid_convention: All buttons, inputs, tabs, risk tags, and cards must include role-based data-testid (e.g., data-testid='start-screening-button', data-testid='patient-search-input')

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact color theme and typography structure across all files.
Implement full mock sensor data generation when live WebSocket is offline, with real-time chart updates in SensorDashboard.
Ensure every route/tab includes proper loading states, interactive micro-animations using Framer Motion or Tailwind transitions, and Sonner toast notifications.
Do not use dark gradients or full screen dark blankets. Keep the surface warm, clinical, light, and approachable.
All interactive components MUST feature data-testid attributes.
